articles.title: Global AI Trade Unwind Drives Foreign Investors Back to Indian Equities
articles.excerpt: After selling $29 billion in the first half of 2026, foreign investors turned net buyers of Indian stocks in July as a pullback in AI-linked markets triggered a major rotation into India's diversified benchmarks.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with portfolios spanning U.S. tech and Indian equities face rebalancing decisions as the AI-to-India rotation reshapes global flows.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Juniper Green Energy IPO Closes 8x Oversubscribed as Institutions Drive Final-Day Surge
articles.excerpt: The ₹1,800 crore renewable energy IPO saw QIB demand reach 26x on its last day, though retail investors stayed cautious at just 0.68x subscription.
articles.nri_angle: India's renewable energy sector draws global capital including Abu Dhabi Investment Authority; NRI investors tracking India's clean energy transition will note the strong institutional backing despite muted retail participation.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Fed's Williams Expects Inflation to Ease but Warns Rate Hikes Remain on the Table
articles.excerpt: The New York Fed president said disinflationary forces should reassert themselves, but the central bank stands ready to raise borrowing costs if price pressures persist above the 2% target.
articles.nri_angle: Persistent US inflation and potential rate hikes affect Indian-American purchasing power, dollar-rupee remittance values, and the large diaspora workforce in AI and tech sectors.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RBI Expected to Hold Repo Rate at 5.25% as Global Peers Pivot to Hikes
articles.excerpt: Nearly 95% of economists in a Reuters poll predict the central bank will keep rates unchanged when the MPC announces its decision on Wednesday, choosing to look through rising inflation rather than follow peers into tightening.
articles.nri_angle: The RBI's capital-inflow measures and NRI deposit scheme enhancements directly affect diaspora investors, while a potential future rate hike cycle could reshape fixed-income and equity allocations for those with Indian exposure.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SEBI Bars Zee's Subhash Chandra and Punit Goenka From Securities Market for One Year
articles.excerpt: India's market regulator imposed ₹1.48 crore in penalties on Zee Entertainment, its CEO, and founder-chairman emeritus after finding company land was secretly pledged for promoter-linked loans.
articles.image_caption: Subhash Chandra, founder of Zee Entertainment, has been barred from the securities market by SEBI for one year.
articles.nri_angle: Zee channels are widely watched by the Indian diaspora, and the governance issues may concern NRI investors holding ZEEL shares or mutual funds with exposure to the stock.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bharti Airtel, Trent, SBI Among 215 Stocks to Report Q1 Results This Week
articles.excerpt: India's busiest earnings week of the season features heavyweights across telecom, real estate, retail, and banking, with multiple sectors expected to show profit declines.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with exposure to Indian equities face a pivotal week as major holdings across telecom, banking, and consumer sectors report numbers that will shape portfolio decisions.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Trump's Pharma Tariff Countdown Begins, Indian Generic Drugmakers Face Uncertain Future
articles.excerpt: With a two-year grace period now ticking and 100% tariffs on generic drugs set for 2028, India's $8.7 billion pharmaceutical export pipeline to the US faces its biggest test yet.
articles.nri_angle: Indian pharmaceutical companies that employ thousands of diaspora professionals face major revenue risk, while generic drug tariffs could raise medication costs for Indian-Americans who rely on affordable generics.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Persistent Systems Reports Rs 483 Crore Q1 Profit as Nagarro Deal Dominates Outlook
articles.excerpt: The mid-tier IT firm's net profit rose 13.7% year-on-year but fell 9% sequentially, as the spotlight shifts to its transformative $2.9 billion Nagarro acquisition.
articles.image_caption: Persistent Systems reported quarterly profit of Rs 483 crore, with its Nagarro acquisition shaping the company's outlook.
articles.nri_angle: Persistent Systems, a major employer of Indian tech talent, is making India's largest cross-border IT acquisition, reshaping the global IT services pecking order.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb in Talks on $400 Billion Pharma Megadeal
articles.excerpt: The potential tie-up would create one of the world's largest pharmaceutical companies, combining AstraZeneca's oncology dominance with Bristol Myers' immunology portfolio.
articles.nri_angle: A deal of this magnitude would reshape the global pharmaceutical landscape, with implications for drug pricing and availability across markets including India
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: S&P 500 Earnings Beats Hit Five-Year Highs as Consumers Absorb Surging Costs
articles.excerpt: Corporate America is posting its strongest profit season since 2021, driven by AI spending and soaring energy margins, even as gasoline prices above $4 a gallon and rising inflation squeeze household budgets.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American investors benefit from an earnings-driven stock rally while Indian IT firms stand to gain from the AI infrastructure spending powering tech profits, though rising energy and living costs weigh on household budgets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dalal Street Braces for Record August Week with 11 Listings and Fresh IPO Pipeline
articles.excerpt: After a blockbuster July headlined by Indo-MIM's 44% listing pop, India's primary market stays hot with ₹9,500 crore worth of new issues and nearly a dozen market debuts slated for early August.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors can participate in India's current IPO boom through NRE/NRO demat accounts, with opportunities spanning healthcare, green energy, and precision manufacturing sectors.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Buffett's Preferred Vanguard S&P 500 ETF Turns $10,000 Into Over $42,000 in 12 Years
articles.excerpt: Warren Buffett has championed the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF since 2014, and the numbers have vindicated his advice — with the fund delivering nearly 13% annual returns and outperforming the vast majority of professional fund managers.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian Americans and NRIs balancing portfolios across markets, Buffett's Vanguard S&P 500 ETF offers diversified U.S. exposure without stock-picking complexity.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: OPEC+ Approves Sixth Straight Output Hike, Then Plans to Pause Through Year-End
articles.excerpt: Seven OPEC+ producers will add 188,000 barrels per day in September, completing the rollback of 2023 voluntary cuts. The group then plans to freeze quotas through Q4 as it tackles the thornier question of 2027 production baselines.
articles.nri_angle: India imports 85% of its crude oil; sustained high prices strain its fiscal and current account deficits, while normalized Gulf flows could ease fuel inflation.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tata Sons Profit Climbs 22% but Air India Losses Double to ₹22,238 Crore
articles.excerpt: The holding company's standalone net profit rose to ₹31,961 crore in FY26, even as its flagship airline posted a net loss of $2.32 billion and extended its turnaround timeline to a decade.
articles.nri_angle: Tata Group's financial performance directly affects millions of diaspora investors holding shares in listed companies like TCS, Tata Motors and Tata Steel, while Air India's service quality and route network shape the travel experience for NRIs flying to India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Loan Investors Dig In as Credit Fears Sweep the Leveraged Finance Market
articles.excerpt: Fund outflows hit a one-year high, redemption gates are going up at major firms, and lenders are demanding tougher covenants as the $1.2 trillion leveraged loan market enters a defensive phase.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin professionals and investors in the U.S. hold indirect exposure to leveraged loans through 401(k) plans and alternative investment allocations, and the gating of redemptions at major funds underscores a liquidity risk often invisible in portfolio statements.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Foreign Investors Have Pulled ₹2.87 Lakh Crore From India as AI Trade Reshapes Global Flows
articles.excerpt: Premium valuations, the global AI-chip rotation into Korea and Taiwan, and geopolitical risk have driven the sharpest FPI exodus in years — but domestic institutions are absorbing every rupee.
articles.image_caption: Foreign institutional investors have withdrawn ₹2.87 lakh crore from Indian markets
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors watching Indian market valuations should note that while FPI selling has been relentless, domestic mutual fund inflows have kept markets resilient, fundamentally changing India's equity funding structure.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: UPI Smashes Monthly Record With 23.66 Billion Transactions in July
articles.excerpt: India's digital payments juggernaut set another all-time high, processing nearly 24 billion transactions in a single month as the platform expands to eight countries.
articles.nri_angle: UPI's global expansion to eight countries means NRIs can increasingly use the system abroad, while its record volumes underscore India's lead in real-time digital payments infrastructure.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Muthoot Finance Q1 Profit Jumps 43% as Gold Loan Book Approaches ₹2 Lakh Crore
articles.excerpt: India's largest gold loan financier extends its growth streak into FY27, driven by record gold prices and RBI's new gold loan framework that favours organised lenders.
articles.nri_angle: Muthoot Finance is widely held by NRI investors and its gold loan growth reflects broader trends in Indian household credit and gold-backed lending that affect diaspora portfolios.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RBI Swap Facility Draws $40.8 Billion in Foreign Inflows as Rupee Defence Gathers Steam
articles.excerpt: Foreign currency deposits account for the bulk of inflows under the central bank's concessional hedging programme, with SBI Research projecting up to $85 billion by year-end.
articles.nri_angle: NRI depositors benefit directly from zero-cost hedging on FCNR deposits, making India a more attractive destination for overseas savings.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Minnesota Bans Crypto ATMs After Residents Report Nearly $1 Million in Scam Losses
articles.excerpt: The state becomes the third in the US to prohibit cryptocurrency kiosks as the FBI reports $333 million in nationwide ATM-linked fraud losses last year.
articles.nri_angle: Indian Americans and other immigrant communities who use cash-based financial services should be aware of growing cryptocurrency kiosk fraud risks as regulation remains in flux.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nearly 30% of American Car Buyers Are Rolling Record Debt Into New Vehicles
articles.excerpt: Average negative equity on trade-ins hit $6,884 in Q2 2026, as pandemic-era buyers return to dealerships carrying thousands in underwater loans amid elevated interest rates.
articles.nri_angle: Indian Americans who bought vehicles during the 2022 shortage may be carrying significant negative equity and should check loan balances against current market values before trading in.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Honda India Two-Wheeler Sales Hit 5.43 Lakh Units in July, Eyes Premium Push
articles.excerpt: Domestic dispatches rose 2% to 4.76 lakh units while exports surged 35%, as Honda prepares its biggest product offensive with the ADV 160, Rebel 300 and locally-built 500cc motorcycles.
articles.nri_angle: Honda's premium push — including locally-built 300-500cc motorcycles at competitive prices — could interest NRI enthusiasts tracking India's evolving two-wheeler market.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Kia India Posts Record July Sales at 28,200 Units, Up 27%
articles.excerpt: The Korean automaker's best-ever July performance brings year-to-date wholesale dispatches to nearly 1.92 lakh units, driven by Seltos, Sonet and new EV launches.
articles.nri_angle: Kia India's record July dispatch of 28,200 units and 27% YoY growth signal continued strength in the Indian passenger vehicle market, where the Korean automaker targets 302,000 sales for 2026.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: ATF Prices Hiked 3% While Commercial LPG Gets Fifth Straight Monthly Cut
articles.excerpt: Aviation turbine fuel rises Rs 2,678 per kilolitre as geopolitical tensions push up oil rates, while commercial cooking gas falls Rs 33.50 per cylinder in the August 1 revision.
articles.nri_angle: Higher ATF prices could translate to costlier domestic and international airfares, affecting NRIs planning trips to India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Cabinet Approves Rs 84,084 Crore 'Samudra Manthan' Scheme for Oil and Gas Exploration
articles.excerpt: India's cabinet greenlit a massive exploration push to reduce crude oil import dependence, with incentives spanning deep-water drilling and unconventional hydrocarbon development.
articles.nri_angle: Major policy shift for India's energy security, with investment implications for NRIs holding upstream and E&P stocks.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's GST Collections Hit 14-Month High, Cross Rs 2 Lakh Crore for Second Time in FY27
articles.excerpt: July gross GST revenue surged past the Rs 2 lakh crore mark, driven by strong domestic consumption and rising import-linked tax collections.
articles.nri_angle: Strong GST data signals robust Indian economic fundamentals for NRI investors tracking macro indicators.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bond Selloff Sends 30-Year Yield to 19-Year High as Fed Credibility Wavers
articles.excerpt: Three FOMC dissenters wanted a rate hike, and the bond market's verdict on Chairman Warsh's inflation stance was swift and brutal.
articles.image_caption: The Federal Reserve headquarters in Washington, D.C. The 30-year Treasury yield has surged to its highest level in 19 years as investors question the central bank's inflation-fighting credibility.
articles.nri_angle: Rising U.S. bond yields push mortgage rates higher, directly affecting Indian Americans' home-buying costs, while potentially drawing investment away from emerging markets including India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: From Beer to Paint to French Fries, the Iran War Is Hitting American Wallets
articles.excerpt: The Strait of Hormuz closure is pushing up costs for raw materials and freight, forcing companies from Boston Beer to Sherwin-Williams to raise prices on everyday goods.
articles.nri_angle: Rising U.S. consumer prices from the conflict affect Indian Americans' cost of living while creating opportunities in commodity-linked Indian equities.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: NALCO Q1 Profit Jumps 91% to ₹2,003 Crore on Surging Aluminium Prices
articles.excerpt: India's state-owned aluminium producer posts its strongest quarterly profit since FY26's record year, driven by higher metal realizations and expanded production volumes.
articles.nri_angle: NALCO's strong results offer Indian diaspora investors a metals-sector play backed by government ownership and vertically integrated operations in Odisha.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Oil Crisis Fuels Global EV Boom as 50 Countries Break Quarterly Sales Records
articles.excerpt: The IEA says electric vehicles will account for 29 percent of global car sales in 2026, with India, Europe, and Latin America leading the surge.
articles.nri_angle: India hitting record EV sales is significant for NRI investors watching Tata Motors, Mahindra EV, and Ola Electric, while the broader shift reshapes energy portfolios.

articles.title: SEBI Clears Path for NSE's Mega IPO With ₹1,491 Crore Settlement
articles.excerpt: India's largest stock exchange resolves decade-old co-location dispute, removing the last regulatory barrier to what could be the country's biggest listing this year.
articles.nri_angle: NSE's IPO would give NRI investors direct ownership in India's primary trading infrastructure, while the exchange's derivatives volume directly affects portfolio hedging strategies.

articles.title: Trump Orders Curbs on Critical Minerals Scrap Exports to Counter China's Dominance
articles.excerpt: The presidential order empowers the Commerce Department to block e-waste exports, targeting tungsten and battery black mass to boost domestic recycling and reduce reliance on Chinese mineral supply chains.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American professionals in tech, defense, and manufacturing industries could see supply chain shifts and new domestic investment opportunities as the U.S. reshapes its critical minerals strategy.

articles.title: Tata Steel Greenlights ₹33,873 Crore NINL Expansion to Double Long Products Capacity
articles.excerpt: The board approved a 4.8 MTPA expansion at Neelachal Ispat Nigam in Odisha alongside strong Q1 results, with net profit rising 19% to ₹2,385 crore.
articles.nri_angle: The expansion positions Tata Steel as a stronger play for NRI investors eyeing India's infrastructure-led growth cycle, while the improving financials and domestic capacity build reduce the group's dependence on volatile European operations.

articles.title: Black Sea Grain Exports Face Total Shutdown as Russia-Ukraine Attacks Escalate
articles.excerpt: Russia's grain lobby warns Ukrainian drone strikes could block all Black Sea export corridors, threatening food security across Africa and the Middle East as wheat prices surge.
articles.image_caption: The Port of Odesa, a key Black Sea grain export hub now facing potential shutdown amid escalating Russia-Ukraine attacks.
articles.nri_angle: Rising global wheat prices and supply disruptions in the Black Sea region could affect food costs for Indian diaspora communities worldwide, while India's recent resumption of wheat exports positions it as an alternative supplier.

articles.title: EU Commits €10 Billion to Build Seven AI Gigafactories in Global Compute Race
articles.excerpt: The European Commission expanded its AI infrastructure plan from five to seven gigafactories after strong demand from member states, with AMD, Nvidia, and Qualcomm signing on as chip suppliers.
articles.nri_angle: The EU's AI gigafactory buildout creates opportunities for Indian tech professionals in AI engineering and data center operations across European markets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Microsoft Adds $450 Billion in One Day, Smashing U.S. Market Cap Record
articles.excerpt: Shares surged 15.5% after blowout earnings showed Azure cloud growth accelerating and AI investments beginning to pay off, easing Wall Street fears about Big Tech spending.
articles.nri_angle: Microsoft employs tens of thousands of Indian-origin tech workers and its cloud and AI growth directly impacts Indian IT services firms like Infosys and TCS that are key Azure partners.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Japan and South Korea Stage Rare Joint Currency Intervention as Yen Surges 3%
articles.excerpt: The coordinated move sent the yen to its strongest level in six months, while the Bank of Japan held rates steady at 1% and the U.S. Treasury called the currency 'very undervalued.'
articles.image_caption: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda has overseen the central bank's historic policy shift
articles.nri_angle: A stronger yen affects Indian IT exports to Japan and signals broader shifts in emerging-market currencies, including the rupee.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Amazon Revenue Hits $201 Billion as AWS Posts Fastest Growth in 18 Quarters
articles.excerpt: Cloud unit revenue surged 37% to $42.2 billion, beating estimates by a wide margin, as Amazon raised its 2026 capex outlook to $220 billion.
articles.nri_angle: Amazon is a major holding for Indian diaspora investors; AWS growth signals continued AI infrastructure demand that benefits Indian IT services firms.

articles.title: Rivian Beats Revenue Estimates, Raises Delivery Outlook as R2 SUV Gains Traction
articles.excerpt: The EV maker posted $1.66 billion in Q2 revenue, a 27% jump, while its mass-market R2 SUV drove higher delivery guidance and a path toward positive gross margins.
articles.nri_angle: Rivian's strong quarter and growing software business—bolstered by its Volkswagen joint venture—signal opportunities for investors tracking the EV sector's evolution amid shifting U.S. policy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Citadel Buys Situational Awareness Stock Portfolio After AI Fund's Collapse
articles.excerpt: Ken Griffin's hedge fund acquires the leveraged portion of Leopold Aschenbrenner's AI-focused portfolio after the former OpenAI researcher's fund was battered by July's tech selloff, triggering relief buying across Wall Street.
articles.nri_angle: Major AI stock selloff and hedge fund dynamics affect global investors including those tracking US tech markets from abroad.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Markets Open Flat as Fed Holds Rates and FII Selling Extends to Third Session
articles.excerpt: Sensex and Nifty trade cautiously amid mixed global cues, with IT stocks showing strength while consumer durables and realty drag.
articles.nri_angle: Fed rate decisions directly affect NRI investment flows and rupee-denominated returns on Indian market holdings.

articles.title: Zepto Targets $3 Billion IPO Valuation, Less Than Half Its Peak
articles.excerpt: The quick-commerce startup has begun anchor investor discussions at a sharp markdown from its $7 billion private valuation, with a possible delay looming if the gap with institutional buyers can't be bridged.
articles.nri_angle: Zepto's $7 billion-to-$3 billion valuation slide is a cautionary signal for NRI investors in India's private startup market, highlighting the widening gap between late-stage private pricing and what public markets will actually pay.

articles.title: Indian Banks Collected Over Rs 7,000 Crore From Account Holders for Low Balance Penalties in FY26
articles.excerpt: The practice continues to burden small depositors despite several public sector banks waiving minimum balance charges in the past year.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs maintaining Indian bank accounts face minimum balance penalties that can quietly drain dormant accounts, making the policy personally relevant to the diaspora.

articles.title: Toyota Launches 9th-Generation Hilux in India Starting at Rs 31.99 Lakh
articles.excerpt: The iconic pickup truck gets a bold 'Cyber Sumo' redesign, a first-ever 4x2 variant, and a cabin packed with new tech — with test drives beginning July 29.
articles.nri_angle: The Hilux offers NRIs a globally proven, Toyota-backed pickup option for Indian farmland, weekend properties, or adventure travel.

articles.title: L&T Profit Rises 14% as India's Q1 Earnings Season Delivers Mixed Signals
articles.excerpt: Larsen & Toubro and Radico Khaitan post strong growth, but Hindustan Unilever and Suzlon Energy see profit dip as geopolitical headwinds weigh on select sectors.

articles.title: Nasdaq 100 Enters Correction Territory as AI Spending Fears and China's Chip Breakthrough Rattle Markets
articles.excerpt: The tech-heavy index fell 10% from its June peak as a chip stock rout deepened on concerns over massive AI capital expenditure and reports of Chinese semiconductor advances.
articles.nri_angle: Indian diaspora investors with US tech exposure face portfolio implications; Nifty IT index companies could see pressure if AI spending pullback extends to enterprise budgets

articles.title: Pakistan's Business Community Alleges Silent Visa Ban by UAE as Export Losses Mount
articles.excerpt: Pakistani officials confirm the UAE has halted most visa issuance for its nationals, threatening $6.3 billion in annual remittances and disrupting bilateral trade.
articles.image_caption: Pakistan's business community has raised alarms over what it calls a silent visa ban by the UAE, with export losses mounting since March 2026.
articles.nri_angle: Gulf visa restrictions affect all South Asian expatriate communities; India's 3.5 million UAE diaspora watches as policy shifts can reshape communities overnight
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: HDFC Bank Board Fines CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan Over Deposit Pricing Overreach
articles.excerpt: India's largest private lender concludes its internal review of the MSRDC deposit arrangement, finding business overreach but no misconduct or personal enrichment.
articles.image_caption: Sashidhar Jagdishan, CEO of HDFC Bank. The bank's board imposed a financial penalty on him over a deposit pricing dispute.
articles.nri_angle: HDFC Bank is the largest private bank in India and a major holding in most NRI investment portfolios and mutual funds.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's NRI Deposit Drive May Hit $70 Billion as Banks Shatter 2013 Record in Just 45 Days
articles.excerpt: SBI Research sharply raises FCNR(B) projections as total RBI-linked forex inflows could reach $85 billion, potentially swinging India's balance of payments to a $50 billion surplus.
articles.image_caption: India's NRI deposit drive has attracted record inflows as banks offer higher rates on foreign currency deposits.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs can earn up to 6.5% on dollar deposits through FCNR(B) schemes, with leveraged returns potentially exceeding 20% — a direct investment opportunity.

articles.title: Tata Sons Posts ₹32,000 Crore Profit in FY26 as Air India Losses Balloon to Record Levels
articles.excerpt: The Tata holding company's standalone profit surged 22% to ₹32,000 crore, but Air India's estimated ₹22,000 crore loss and a leadership vacuum at the airline cast a shadow over the recovery.
articles.nri_angle: Air India's service disruptions and costlier rerouted flights directly affect the Indian diaspora, particularly on high-traffic US, UK, and Gulf routes that connect families across continents.

articles.title: India's Jobs Paradox: Two in Three Unemployed Youth Are Now Graduates
articles.excerpt: Azim Premji University's State of Working India 2026 report reveals that graduate unemployment has remained stuck between 35 and 40 percent for four decades, even as India produces five million graduates a year.
articles.image_caption: Indian university graduates at a convocation ceremony. A new report finds nearly 40 percent of graduates aged 15 to 25 are unemployed.
articles.nri_angle: Stagnant graduate employment outcomes and rising credentialism raise questions about the returns on education investments many diaspora families help fund for relatives in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AU Small Finance Bank Raises NRI Deposit Rates Amid India's Record Dollar Drive
articles.excerpt: The bank hiked FCNR rates to 7.10% and introduced zero-cost remittances as part of a broader RBI-backed push that has drawn $32 billion in foreign currency inflows.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs can now earn up to 7.10% on dollar deposits with zero forex charges on remittances, a sharp improvement from rates below 5.15% just weeks earlier.
